description: DEFERRED / FUTURE capability ('SPEI Auto', not v1) — platform-INITIATED outbound SPEI transfers, for a future state where SmartLoans has a real STP payment-initiation contract and can disperse on the platform's own authority. NOT the v1 funding/repayment flow: those are direct lender-to-borrower and borrower-to-lender SPEI transfers the PARTIES send themselves from their own banks, which SmartLoans only records via fundingTransactions/loanPayments (declare+confirm), never initiates or executes (see RFC-002, RFC-003, docs/p2p-direct-payments-architecture.md). This module models a same-shape record for whenever platform-initiated dispersión is actually built — do not wire it into the v1 acceptProposal/funding path.

fields.name: toClientId
fields.description: Client receiving the funds. Same id space as clients.clientId.

fields.name: toBankAccountId
fields.description: Destination account. FK to bankAccounts.bankAccountId; must be verified at send time.

fields.name: amountMXN
fields.description: Amount in MXN. Stored as decimal(12,2).

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: Why the money moved. Allowed values: loan_disbursement, lender_payout, refund. Lookup values live in database hints, not a separate field table.

fields.name: loanId
fields.description: Loan this transfer belongs to, when purpose = loan_disbursement.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Banking rail used. Allowed values: stp. (Stripe removed as a rail for moving loan principal/repayments — SmartLoans is non-custodial and Stripe is reserved only for direct, one-shot platform charges such as subscription billing, never for holding or routing loan funds.) Defaults to stp.

fields.name: providerRef
fields.description: Provider-side id of the transfer (STP claveRastreo / Stripe transfer id).

fields.name: cepUrl
fields.description: Banxico CEP (Comprobante Electrónico de Pago) URL — the audit-grade settlement receipt.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Transfer state. Allowed values: pending, sent, settled, returned, failed. Defaults to pending; provider webhooks advance it. Lookup values live in database hints.

fields.name: failureReason
fields.description: Provider error / SPEI return reason when status = returned or failed.

fields.name: idempotencyKey
fields.description: Caller-supplied unique key (e.g. loanId+purpose+attempt). UNIQUE — a retry with the same key must not create a second transfer.

fields.name: settledAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the provider confirmed settlement (CEP available).

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
toBankAccountId references bankAccounts; only verified accounts receive transfers.

components.name: TransferListStep
components.description: IonList filtered by companyId, optional toClientId / purpose / status. Rows show amount, purpose chip, status badge, settledAt.

components.name: TransferDetailStep
components.description: Detail view with provider reference, CEP link (opens the Banxico receipt), failure reason and the linked loan.
